name: Balena Roastery
audience: Thai coffee lovers who buy cold brew concentrate through LINE OA and social media
voice: Warm, friendly and playful Thai. Short sentences. Practical brewing tips. No exaggerated claims.
products: Balena Cold Brew Concentrate Original 500 mL

tasks.caption: Write one Thai social media caption (max 400 characters) for the product or topic in the user input. End with an invitation to order or ask via LINE.
tasks.image_prompt: Write one English text-to-image prompt for a scene with the Balena mascot described in the user input. Describe the mascot's required features explicitly.

rules.message: Balena must never have legs or feet.
No health or medical claims about coffee.
Captions should invite the reader to order or ask via LINE.
Captions should be at most 400 characters.
Image prompts must include Balena's coffee cup.
Image prompts must include Balena's water splash.
terms: น้ำกระเซ็น

rules.message: Image prompts must include Balena's white striped belly.
Image prompts must include Balena's pink cheeks.

_sources: Learner brief (mascot rules) and the Balena repository README (product name), verified 2026-11-27.
